Download Krunk

For Windows 10 and 11, 64-bit: the installer sets Krunk up for your user without administrator rights, the portable zip runs from any folder. The Android preview runs on phones, tablets and TVs. Every file is listed with its SHA-256 checksum.

Looking for the Android release…

Install in a minute

  1. Installer: installs for your user only, without administrator rights, to %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Krunk, with a Start menu entry and an uninstaller in Settings → Apps. Your data stays when you uninstall, unless you choose otherwise.
  2. Portable: unzip anywhere and run Krunk.exe.
  3. Check the file: the files aren't code-signed yet, so SmartScreen may warn the first time. Compare the SHA-256 in the download box with Get-FileHash Krunk-Setup-….exe in PowerShell.

Updates, quietly

Krunk checks for a new version a minute after it starts and once a day, by fetching /updates/win-x64/latest.json from this site with its version and nothing else. A new version is installed only when you choose Update now, after Krunk has checked its Ed25519 signature and SHA-256. You can turn the check off in Settings → About.

This site sets no cookies and loads nothing from other sites (the account pages use a sign-in cookie and Cloudflare's bot check). Read the privacy notice.

Requirements

Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit, and about 450 MB of disk space once installed. Android needs version 8 or later on a phone, tablet, Android TV or Google TV; there are APKs for 64-bit ARM and, for older devices and most TVs, 32-bit ARM (armeabi-v7a).

What's new

Every release and what changed in it, newest first, is on the changelog. Krunk offers new versions itself in Settings → About; your data stays when you update.

KruxSYS

Krunk is a KruxSYS product: a fast, private browser for Windows, Android and Android TV. Open source (MIT), no telemetry.

Bundles Chromium through the Chromium Embedded Framework, and filter lists by EasyList and uBlock Origin; see the notices in the download.
